correctness.rationale: Mean generator is M-I. A positive coefficient two-exponential representation and its at-most-one-stationary-point derivative establish all time signs and unique positive crossings. The characteristic equation at unmoderated eigenvalue gives sign D; a 2-by-2 resolvent yields exact progeny sign and wedge; derivative sign then proves finite-horizon ordering. Exact rational witness and packaged seeded finite checks pass, though tests are not a proof.

value.rationale: Identifies the natural discrepancy between three practically distinct diffusion observables—initial concurrent activity, asymptotic reproduction, and total expected progeny—and gives sharp feasibility conditions and a finite-horizon implication. The object is motivated by observed cross-platform displaced information diffusion, not an arbitrary numerical parameter slice. Limits of linear infinite-audience model are explicit.
